publishedData.heading: A legacy built for the future
publishedData.subheading: Engineered for those whose aspirations know no horizon.
publishedData.paragraph1: Located in Subhash Nagar, Chembur, this residential redevelopment offers a practical yet elevated living experience. Comprising 1 & 2 BHK residences in Ground-Level Commercial Spaces + 16-Story Habitational Floors, the project is planned with a strong focus on functionality and lifestyle — adding daily convenience, a modern gymnasium/fitness center, and lifestyle amenities, ensuring a well-rounded living environment for residents.
